items.title: Daði Freyr og Sinfó
items.why: Daði Freyr is known for quirky techno songs, so seeing his music come to life with the Icelandic Symphony would definitely be a crazy flex. Two Icelandic gems on one stage.

items.title: Púðursykur
items.why: We've been to a couple of these standup shows and it is always very entertaining. All the comedians are amazing and it's in a cozy venue. It's giving New York comedy cellar.

items.title: The Streets with Úlfur Úlfur
items.why: This is without a doubt one of the most exciting events this week!
